author: Tracy Lichtenberger
text: Al’s took our call at 1 am for emergency septic services. They arrived and were done within  two hours! In the middle of the night! Also, I truly appreciated a human answering the phone vs AI assistants that many bigger companies use!!! Will continue to use this company to service our septic system in the future!

author: Brenda Manley
text: Great job, cannot say enough about how nice this young man is. Does a great job, very prompt, kept us well informed about what we needed. Thank you Andy!!

author: Mona Lord
text: Very happy with Als Septic. They are friendly and do their best to provide good service. Reasonable rates.

author: Nick Price
text: Called on 03/16/26 for an emergency pump out. Al assured me they could fit me in tomorrow morning 03/17/26. Waited all morning for him, no call, no text, tried to call, left a message to no response!

author: Beth Wood
text: They came the day I called and did a good job.
